static_traits.name: Hai Li
static_traits.family_status: The husband is a US Army soldier and is expecting the first child; the father is a missionary
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友，但尚not yet与他们分享关于与丈夫关系的担忧
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理治疗经历；not yet曾出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 配合度高，表达清晰，能进行自我Reflection；受Anxiety影响，倾向于灾难化、读心术与个体化推断

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得丈夫可能恨我，因为他在得知我怀孕后一直保持沉默，这让我感到Anxiety和恐惧。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为围绕与丈夫关系的Anxiety和恐惧变得hard to bear，影响到了我的日常生活与身心健康。
growth_experiences: Family of origin: father is a missionary.
教育与角色转变：High school graduate后主要承担Homemaker角色。
Marriage and partner background: married to a serviceman husband who is currently in service.

core_beliefs: I will be rejected/disliked by others because of my faults

special_situations.event: The husband has remained silent since learning about my pregnancy
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Silence equals being angry at or disliking me, meaning the relationship has a serious problem
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 频繁尝试与他沟通并在脑中反复猜测其想法，Reinforcement警觉
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他恨我；他not想要这个孩子

special_situations.event: When I brought up the topic of pregnancy, my husband became more distant
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果伴侣have not立刻积极回应，就代表他negate我和孩子
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避向朋友寻求支持，独自承受Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他not愿做父亲，事情正在变得更糟

special_situations.event: 我have not第一时间告诉丈夫自己怀孕
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not及时告知重大消息，就说明我做错了，理应被责怪或被讨厌
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自责、反复Reflection自己的过失并将问题归因于自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I did something wrong, so he hates me

special_situations.event: Whenever husband is quiet or seems distant
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他一直沉默，not yet来关系必然恶化
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度关注其行为、持续担忧与insomnia以试图掌控not确定性

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be explicitly accepted, understood, and cherished by her husband; the relationship safe and stable
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected/被讨厌；害怕关系失去与亲密破裂
defense_goal: 通过自我归责与提前假设他人意图来降低not确定性、获得控制感与安全感

object_relations.self_representation: 内疚与not安的妻子，担心自己“做错了”
object_relations.object_representation: 沉默、可能会拒绝或negate自己的丈夫

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the husband stays silent or seems distant
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将沉默视为对自己的negate与厌恶（移情：把not被爱的恐惧Projection到对方的意图上）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、探询的语气，避免断言对方意图；以“我”的感受陈述和澄清性问题来寻求信息。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当面对not确定性（without法得知丈夫真实感受与态度）时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Fills the gaps with catastrophic imagination, believing the relationship will deteriorate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Encourages reality testing and evidence gathering, gradually proposes concrete, verifiable hypotheses and carries out small-step tentative communication.

manifestations: 丈夫沉默与疏离带来的not被理解与孤立感
对朋友隐而not谈、缺乏外部支持的分享

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse that should originally be expressed outward or seek others' help, turning the energy onto themselves.
manifestations: 对朋友隐而not谈婚姻担忧，选择独自承受Anxiety
Excessive self-blame and internal rumination instead of proactively seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 将丈夫的沉默解读为“他恨我”“他not想要这个孩子”
Inferring the other party's negative intentions without evidence

positive_force: Has a certain degree of social support (has several close friends)
Willing to seek professional help and try recording thoughts and conducting reality testing
Able to recall and acknowledge that the husband tended to stay silent under pressure in the past, providing clues for alternative explanations
negative_force: 灾难化与读心术倾向显著，易在not确定情境中跳到结论
Excessive personalization, attributing the negative meanings of others' behavior to one's own faults
not确定性耐受度较低，导致Persistent anxiety、Sleep affected与Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: 在丈夫沉默或疏远时出现Significant anxiety并伴随灾难化、读心式假设
antecedent: Husband remaining silent after learning of the pregnancy
Husband becoming more distant when pregnancy is discussed
without法从丈夫处获得明确回应与信息
target_behavior.core_reason: 将沉默视为负面评价与拒绝的证据，受灾难化、读心术与个体化思维影响以试图控制not确定性
target_behavior.function: 通过高度警觉与预设最坏结果来试图获得确定性、避免Being rejected的风险
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep affected、Decreased attention、Persistent anxiety与恐惧，夫妻沟通受阻、Relationship tension加剧
